title: Chat/set direct dup re-check is method serverFail
description: chat.rs ~L897: after a direct Chat create_object succeeds, the concurrent-duplicate re-fetch uses map_err(server_fail_from_backend)? so a backend read error becomes a method-level serverFail although the Chat (and earlier creates/updates in the batch) are committed. RFC 8620 §3.6.2: serverFail means 'The method call made no changes to the server's state'. Same class as JMAP-y3f2.16 (a) (destroy prefetch), left out of that bead's scope. Needs a decision: report the create as created (skip dup check) or roll back and report notCreated serverFail.
notes: Mark 2026-10-20 DECISION: Option B. On re-check read failure, destroy_object the just-created Chat and report notCreated serverFail for that create id only, continue the batch (reuse cleanup-failed branch). No method-level error.
